findings: ROOT CAUSE 1 (levelling buys nothing): engine.js applyDerivedPools() opens `const ch=this.sim.character; if(!ch) return null;`. character/derive.js's own header DECLARES this as a deliberate W1-07 reconciliation: 'a loadout with no character behind it keeps RI-CMB03's, so every existing W1-09 scenario measures exactly what it measured before.' So it is not an oversight - it is a cross-piece promise. Fixing it by absolute derivation would move arena hp_max 620->300 and focus 94->30 and break cmb-poise.mjs (hard-codes `hpEnd >= 620` as its VACUITY detector) and every W1-09/W1-14 arena calibration.

combat/system.js:207 `hpMax: loadout.hpMax !== undefined ? loadout.hpMax : 620` - 620 is a hard-coded literal, not data. derivePools({vigour:10,endurance:20,strength:12}) = {hp_max:300, stamina_max:120, focus_max:30}. stamina_max ALREADY agrees exactly (120); only hp and focus disagree.

ROOT CAUSE 2 (vocabulary): sim/state.js:214 makeProgression() seeds SIX Dark-Souls attribute ids {vigour,endurance,strength,dexterity,intelligence,faith}. The DECLARED vocabulary is game/data/progression/attributes.json's TEN {strength,endurance,agility,speed,vigour,willpower,intellect,hist-bond,personality,luck}, which is what character/sheet.js composeAttributes() produces and what ui/system.js _attributes(ctx) draws. dexterity/intelligence/faith exist NOWHERE else in the declared world.

The exact twin of this bug was already fixed once for SKILLS: engine.js _ensureSkillRegister() (W1-14 round 3, GAP-W1-magic-skill-frozen), called from loadState at engine.js:725. The attribute register was left behind.
sim/magic/apply.js:184 hard-codes the same stale six as `const ATTRS`; h_fortify_attribute would write NaN into the register if the keys change. Must be derived from the live register.
_spendSouls (engine.js:3525) is `prog.attributes[attrId] = (prog.attributes[attrId] || 10) + 1` with NO validation - that is what mints the seven fictitious rows at 11.

DESIGN DECISION, declared: absolute derivation on a characterless state would move arena_champion 620->300 HP and 94->30 Focus and break cmb-poise.mjs's own vacuity detector (hpEnd >= 620) plus every W1-09/W1-14 arena calibration. Instead the DECLARED STATBLOCK IS THE ORIGIN: _poolAnchor = {hp_max: b.hpMax - IDENTITY_POOLS.hp_max, stamina_max: ..., willpower: magic.wil - 10} captured in _buildCombat, and the sheet supplies every movement from it. At IDENTITY_ATTRIBUTES the numbers are bit-for-bit unchanged; a VIGOUR point moves hp_max by exactly the curve. The verdict's acceptance is a DELTA test, which this satisfies.
BONUS: hazards.js drains dr.attribute (e.g. 10 AGILITY from the droops) and A['agility'] was undefined in the old six-id register, so the affliction drain silently never fired. It can now.

M-D8 MECHANISM, read off the r2 journey.json rather than the verdict prose: the sample rows carry `on_surface_stain_count: 1`. THE SECOND BLOOM *IS* CREATED. The verdict's 'none is created' is wrong on mechanism. `stains_after: 0` because the trial damages the player IMMEDIATELY after they wake at the hearth, so the second death happens ON the basin, the bloom is placed at the basin, the respawn puts the body back on the basin, and DeathSystem.tryRecover() drinks it inside the 200-frame window. A 0-soul bloom, recovered at range 0.

So M-D8's remedy is in the JOURNEY, not the world: the second death must happen somewhere the player is not about to respawn. Recording `recovered_between` so the mechanism is visible if it ever recurs.

M-D10's `max_frames: 0` is arithmetic, not a world property: damagePlayer(1e5) sets HP to 0 on the same frame it IS the last damage, so frames_since_last_damage is 0 by construction. m_d10b drives a 120 m fall where the GROUND does the damage.

SURFACE_FRAMES = 150 (game/src/sim/death.js:28). The r2 critic's `at_respawn_m` was sampled at deathFrame+201, i.e. **51 frames AFTER the body stood up**, with move:[0,1] still queued and never released. 51 frames x ~0.044 m/frame = 2.26 m; the reported figure was 2.24 m. Its `after_220f_m` is 271 frames of held forward = 9.78 m / 13.97 m = WALKING PACE. So the drift claim needs re-framing, not a fix: measure respawn_pos (the world's own record, written in DeathSystem.respawn()) and control for carried momentum.
